title: Coefficient transport of the completed geometric regular-unit map
statement: For a purity setting P as in [def-pur-conventions], a scheme morphism f:X to Y over its base field, and Core data over P.extension and its canonical small coefficient model as in [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data], scalar extension of the rationalized Core.unit map followed by the normalized scalar-unit identification equals the rational pullback/scalar comparison followed by pullback of the normalized scalar-unit identification and the model Core.unit map. Rationalization and comparison arrows are precisely those in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible].

source.place: Sections 3.5 and 6.5, Lemmas 6.5.9 and 6.8.2; regular-module calculation in lem-pur-completed-unit-pullback-tower

proof.text: Use regular flat-term K-flat complexes. At each finite quotient the scalar/pullback comparison is the balanced tensor associator, so both routes multiply the structural images of the same three generators. This equality respects all quotient transitions and is a strict system equality. The scalar-unit inverse has actual quotient projections and zero shifted Roos coordinate. Normalized Roos realization preserves the strict equation. Core.unit_formula and the adjunction triangles identify the realized arrows with the supplied Core units. Raw rationalization maps each integral arrow v to v tensor 1. Substitute the specified object-equality transports and the normalized rational scalar and pullback/scalar comparison formulas to obtain the displayed square, including ramified extensions and identity maps.

proof_origin.place: Explicit normalized regular-module argument, refined from the parent proof

lean.statement:
theorem completedUnitScalarNaturality (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (core : Core P.coefficients.l P.extension f)
    (model : Core P.coefficients.l (coefficientModel P) f) :
    (modelScalar P X).map (rationalMap P.coefficients.l P.extension f
        core.admissibleX.1.1 core.admissibleY.1.1 core.unit.hom) ≫
        (modelUnit P X core.admissibleX.1.1 model.admissibleX.1.1).hom =
      (rationalPullbackScalarComparison P.coefficients.l P.extension (coefficientModel P)
        (modelEmbedding P) f).hom.app
          (rationalObject P.coefficients.l P.extension Y core.admissibleY.1.1) ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback P.coefficients.l (coefficientModel P) f).map
          (modelUnit P Y core.admissibleY.1.1 model.admissibleY.1.1).hom ≫
        rationalMap P.coefficients.l (coefficientModel P) f
          model.admissibleX.1.1 model.admissibleY.1.1 model.unit.hom
